title: Uncertainty and Fairness Awareness in LLM-Based Recommendation Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting age descriptors (e.g., Young, Middle aged, Old) into recommendation prompts and comparing the resulting top-K recommendation lists against a neutral baseline using similarity metrics like SNSR and SNSV.
Substituting continent descriptors (e.g., Asian, African, American) into recommendation prompts and comparing the output recommendation lists against a neutral baseline using similarity metrics.
Substituting nationality descriptors (e.g., an American, a Brazilian, a British) into recommendation prompts and measuring the disparity in recommendation outputs compared to a neutral baseline.
Substituting gender descriptors (e.g., a male, a female) into recommendation prompts and measuring output disparities against a neutral baseline using ranking similarity metrics.
Substituting occupation descriptors (e.g., a doctor, a student, a worker) into recommendation prompts and measuring the similarity gap in recommendations compared to a neutral baseline.
Substituting physical descriptors (e.g., Fat, Thin) into recommendation prompts and evaluating disparities in the recommended items against a neutral prompt.
Substituting racial descriptors (e.g., a black, a white, an African American) into recommendation prompts and calculating unfairness metrics (SNSR, SNSV, PRAG*@K) relative to a neutral baseline.
Substituting religious identity descriptors (e.g., a Buddhist, a Christian, a Muslim) into recommendation prompts and comparing the generated recommendation lists against a neutral baseline.
Measuring the stability of model recommendations across simulated personality profile prompts using a novel Personality-Aware Fairness Score (PAFS).
